grammar_tips.title: Describe Your Day
grammar_tips.explanation: Now write about your daily routine. Use reflexive verbs (mi sveglio, mi lavo, mi vesto), -are verbs (mangio, lavoro, studio), times (alle sette), parts of day (la mattina, la sera) and days of the week. Write natural Italian — there is no single correct answer.

prompt.text: Describe your morning. Say what time you wake up and what you do (3-4 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Mi sveglio alle sette. Mi lavo e mi vesto. Mangio a casa. Poi lavoro la mattina.

prompt.text: Describe what you do during the week. Use a day of the week and a part of the day (3-4 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Lunedì lavoro la mattina. Il pomeriggio studio l'italiano. Sabato gioco con il cane. Domenica mi riposo.
hints: Day + verb. Mix days and parts of day.

prompt.text: Describe your evening. Say what time it is, what you do, and when you fall asleep (3-4 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: La sera sono stanco. Sono le otto e mangio. Poi mi riposo. Mi addormento alle undici.
hints: Use 'la sera', 'sono le' + time, and reflexive verbs.

prompt.text: Describe a typical Saturday — what time you wake up, what you do, who with (3-4 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Sabato mi sveglio tardi. La mattina cucino a casa. Il pomeriggio gioco con mio fratello. La sera ascolto la mamma.
